description: Defines the ChunkedUploadDataStream class and its nested Writer class for handling chunked data uploads with buffering, including methods for appending data, creating writers, and internal stream management.

classes.name: ChunkedUploadDataStream
classes.description: A push-based data stream class for uploading data in chunks, buffering all data until completion.

classes.name: ChunkedUploadDataStream::Writer
classes.description: Utility class for writing data to a ChunkedUploadDataStream, safe to outlive the stream.

methods.name: CreateWriter
methods.description: Creates a writer object for appending data to the stream.

methods.name: AppendData
methods.description: Appends data to the stream, with an indication if this is the last chunk.
